title.en: Microsoft introduces MAI Image 2.7 editing preview
title.zhHans: Microsoft 推出 MAI Image 2.7 图像编辑预览

searchSummary.en: Microsoft announced MAI Image 2.7 as an image-editing preview on October 27; it is distinct from the 2.6 GA announcement.
searchSummary.zhHans: Microsoft 于 10 月 27 日宣布 MAI Image 2.7 图像编辑预览；这与 2.6 的 GA 公告是不同版本与阶段。

summary.en: Microsoft announced MAI Image 2.7 on October 27 as an image-editing model in preview. A third-party analysis reports no public API, Foundry deployment or price at launch and notes that text-to-image generation was not included. Microsoft also updated separate MAI Image 2.6 and 2.6-Flash general-availability material; that GA status must not be transferred to 2.7. The reported leaderboard position is not treated here as an independent reproduction.
summary.zhHans: Microsoft 于 10 月 27 日宣布图像编辑模型 MAI Image 2.7 进入预览。第三方分析称发布时没有公开 API、Foundry 部署或价格，且不含文生图功能。Microsoft 同时更新了 MAI Image 2.6 与 2.6-Flash 的正式可用材料；该 GA 状态不能套用到 2.7。本稿不将其榜单位置视为独立复现结果。

narrative.en: The node is limited to the 2.7 editing preview. The access limitations are attributed to an independent third-party analysis; the official Microsoft post itself says only that the model launches in preview. Microsoft-reported leaderboard placements and use-case comparisons are not presented as independently reproduced results. The nearby 2.6/2.6-Flash GA update is a separate version and stage.
narrative.zhHans: 本节点仅记录 2.7 图像编辑预览。可用范围限制归于独立第三方分析；Microsoft 官方稿本身只说明模型以预览形式推出。本稿不把 Microsoft 报告的榜单名次和用例比较说成独立复现结果。同期的 2.6/2.6-Flash GA 更新属于不同版本和阶段。

text.en: Microsoft announced MAI Image 2.7 on October 27, 2026 as an image-editing model in preview.
text.zhHans: Microsoft 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日宣布 MAI Image 2.7 图像编辑模型进入预览。

text.en: A third-party analysis reports no public API, Foundry deployment or published price at launch and says text-to-image was not included; this does not establish that such access can never be added.
text.zhHans: 第三方分析称发布时没有公开 API、Foundry 部署或价格，且不含文生图功能；这不代表未来不会增加这些能力或入口。
